definition.description: The meta-CATS tool looks for positions that significantly differ between user-defined groups of sequences.
definition.label: Metadata-driven Comparative Analysis Tool (meta-CATS)

parameters.desc: Path to which the output will be written.
parameters.label: Output Folder

parameters.desc: Basename for the generated output files.
parameters.label: File Basename

parameters.desc: The p-value cutoff for analyzing sequences.
parameters.label: The p-value cutoff.

parameters.desc: The metadata type. Used for reference.
parameters.label: The metadata type.

parameters.desc: Determines which sequence alphabet to use: nucleotide (na) or amino acid (aa).
parameters.label: sequence alphabet

parameters.desc: The location of the alignment file.
parameters.label: The alignment file.

parameters.desc: The location of a file that partitions sequences into groups.
parameters.label: The group file.

group.label: The feature / patric id.

source.content:
{
    "id": "MetaCATS",
    "script": "App-MetaCATS",
    "label": "Metadata-driven Comparative Analysis Tool (meta-CATS)",
    "description": "The meta-CATS tool looks for positions that significantly differ between user-defined groups of sequences.",
    "parameters": [
        {
            "id": "output_path",
            "allow_multiple": false,
            "label": "Output Folder",
            "required": 1,
            "default": null,
            "desc": "Path to which the output will be written.",
            "type": "folder"
        },
        {
            "id": "output_file",
            "allow_multiple": false,
            "label": "File Basename",
            "required": 1,
            "default": null,
            "desc": "Basename for the generated output files.",
            "type": "wsid"
        },
        {
            "id": "p_value",
            "allow_multiple": false,
            "label": "The p-value cutoff.",
            "required": 1,
            "default": 0.05,
            "desc": "The p-value cutoff for analyzing sequences.",
            "type": "float"
        },
        {
            "id": "year_ranges",
            "allow_multiple": false,
            "label": "The year ranges field.",
            "required": 0,
            "desc": "",
            "type": "string"
        },
        {
            "id": "metadata_group",
            "allow_multiple": false,
            "label": "The metadata type.",
            "required": 0,
            "desc": "The metadata type. Used for reference.",
            "type": "string"
        },
        {
            "id": "input_type",
            "allow_multiple": false,
            "label": "The input type.",
            "required": 1,
            "default": null,
            "desc": "The data entry input type.",
            "type": "enum",
            "enum": [
                "auto",
                "groups",
                "files"
            ]
        },
        {
            "id": "alphabet",
            "allow_multiple": false,
            "label": "sequence alphabet",
            "required": 1,
            "default": "na",
            "desc": "Determines which sequence alphabet to use: nucleotide (na) or amino acid (aa).",
            "type": "enum",
            "enum": [
                "na",
                "aa"
            ]
        },
        {
            "id": "groups",
            "allow_multiple": false,
            "required": 0,
            "label": "Feature groups",
            "desc": "Feature groups",
            "default": [],
            "type": "list",
            "wstype": "feature_group"
        },
        {
            "id": "alignment_file",
            "allow_multiple": false,
            "label": "The alignment file.",
            "required": 0,
            "desc": "The location of the alignment file.",
            "wstype": "feature_protein_fasta",
            "type": "wstype"
        },
        {
            "id": "group_file",
            "allow_multiple": false,
            "label": "The group file.",
            "required": 0,
            "desc": "The location of a file that partitions sequences into groups.",
            "wstype": "tsv",
            "type": "wstype"
        },
        {
            "id": "alignment_type",
            "allow_multiple": false,
            "label": "The type of alignment.",
            "required": 0,
            "default": null,
            "desc": "The file format type.",
            "type": "enum",
            "enum": [
                "aligned_dna_fasta",
                "aligned_protein_fasta"
            ]
        },
        {
            "id": "auto_groups",
            "type": "group",
            "allow_multiple": true,
            "required": 0,
            "default": null,
            "group": [
                {
                    "id": "id",
                    "required": 1,
                    "label": "The feature / patric id.",
                    "desc": "An id that uniquely references a DNA/AA string.",
                    "type": "string"
                },
                {
                    "id": "grp",
                    "required": 1,
                    "label": "Group string",
                    "desc": "A string to describe the group to associate the id into.",
                    "type": "string"
                },
                {
                    "id": "g_id",
                    "required": 0,
                    "label": "Genome id",
                    "desc": "Genome id string.",
                    "type": "string"
                },
                {
                    "id": "metadata",
                    "required": 0,
                    "label": "Metadata",
                    "desc": "Original metadata category.",
                    "type": "string"
                }
            ]
        }
    ]
}
